szoveg_eredeti:
GPT-6 Cyber: a major advance for security research, already being used to help defend security-critical software such as the Linux kernel, Firefox, and many other projects.

We’ve invested a great deal in trust, specifically training the model to stay within the scope specified by the operator. The corresponding eval results are quite striking.

We’re also launching Daybreak Red for Critical Infrastructure, giving approved critical infrastructure defenders the ability to conduct authorized testing of critical systems.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Greg Brockman megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: OpenAI (@OpenAI); megjelent: 2026-11-05T17:09:13+00:00; link: https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2118390190246879554; média: videó, 7 másodperc]
Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber: a major advance in security research that pairs stronger capabilities with better model alignment.

The model powered the Linux kernel research we announced yesterday, and security teams at companies like Mozilla, Palo Alto Networks, Calif, and Cisco—alongside our own at OpenAI—are already putting it to work.

GPT-6 Cyber is available to select Daybreak Red customers and we are expanding access over time.
